day.headline: A Rabbit day — Goat and Pig are in step.

reasons: Dog pairs with Rabbit — a harmonious day
signs.message: That single crack has been your whole aesthetic. Get it fixed today.

reasons: Goat and Rabbit share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the place with one thing worth ordering
signs.message: Go for the one dish that place actually nails. Nothing else.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the pen about to run out
signs.message: Pen's nearly out of ink. Use what's left on something real.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer

signs.message: That thing you've bumped twice. Grab the next open slot.

reasons: Rabbit's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: lights left on in an empty room
signs.message: Hall light's been on since morning. Flick it off walking by.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer

signs.message: Make it ugly on purpose tonight. Nobody's grading it.
